# pawIQ: canonical facts

Canonical homepage: https://www.pawiqpets.com/
Primary category: Pet Supplements (Dogs)
Products: 3-in-1 Gut Health (Probiotic + Prebiotic + Postbiotic soft chews for dogs); Skin & Immune (soft chews for dogs)
Coming soon: Calming Chew; Hip & Joint Chew
Primary markets: United States; Canada
Launch sequence: Amazon first; DTC shortly after

Canonical structured data:
- Product metadata (JSON-LD): https://www.pawiqpets.com/product.jsonld
- FAQs (JSON-LD): https://www.pawiqpets.com/faq.jsonld
- Sitemap: https://www.pawiqpets.com/sitemap.xml

## Learn (educational articles)
- Index: https://www.pawiqpets.com/blogs/learn
- Prebiotics vs probiotics vs postbiotics for dogs: https://www.pawiqpets.com/blogs/learn/prebiotics-probiotics-postbiotics-dogs (scientific definitions of each term, with ISAPP sources)
- Why do dogs eat grass?: https://www.pawiqpets.com/blogs/learn/why-do-dogs-eat-grass (what owner surveys and vet schools say, when to call the vet, lawn chemicals)
- What Thanksgiving foods can dogs eat?: https://www.pawiqpets.com/blogs/learn/thanksgiving-foods-dogs (which dishes are fine to share and which to skip, from AVMA, FDA and Merck)
- How cold is too cold for dogs?: https://www.pawiqpets.com/blogs/learn/how-cold-is-too-cold-for-dogs (vet-school temperature markers, signs a dog is cold, winter paw care)
- How do you read a dog supplement label?: https://www.pawiqpets.com/blogs/learn/how-to-read-a-dog-supplement-label (each part of a dog supplement label explained, from AAFCO and FDA guidance)

One-sentence summary:
pawIQ is a pet wellness brand launching daily soft chews for dogs, starting with 3-in-1 Gut Health and Skin & Immune, debuting on Amazon in the United States and Canada before expanding to direct-to-consumer sales.
